events.title: 중국 닝보에서 태어나다
events.description: 중국 저장성 닝보에서 태어났다. 전란을 피해 가족과 여러 도시를 옮겨 다니며 어린 시절을 보냈다.
events.description_en: He was born in Ningbo, Zhejiang province, China. His family moved from city to city fleeing wartime turmoil throughout his childhood.

events.title: 미국으로 건너가 하버드에 들어가다
events.title_en: He moved to the United States and entered Harvard
events.description: 열여덟 나이로 미국으로 건너가 하버드대학교에 입학했다. 이듬해 매사추세츠공대로 옮겨 기계공학을 공부했다.
events.description_en: At eighteen he moved to the United States and entered Harvard University. The next year he transferred to MIT to study mechanical engineering.

events.title: 텍사스인스트루먼츠에 입사하다
events.description: 텍사스인스트루먼츠에 엔지니어로 들어가 반도체 사업을 익혔다. 이후 이십오 년을 이 회사에서 보내며 전 세계 반도체 사업을 총괄하는 수석 부사장까지 올랐다.
events.description_en: He joined Texas Instruments as an engineer and learned the semiconductor business from the ground up. Over twenty-five years there he rose to senior vice president overseeing the company's global semiconductor operations.

events.title: 스탠퍼드에서 전기공학 박사를 받다
events.title_en: He earned his doctorate in electrical engineering at Stanford
events.description: 텍사스인스트루먼츠에 재직하며 스탠퍼드대학교에서 전기공학 박사학위를 받았다.
events.description_en: While working at Texas Instruments, he earned a doctorate in electrical engineering from Stanford University.

events.title: 대만으로 건너가 산업기술연구원을 이끌다
events.title_en: He moved to Taiwan to lead the Industrial Technology Research Institute
events.description: 대만 정부의 초청으로 산업기술연구원 원장을 맡았다. 동시에 유나이티드마이크로일렉트로닉스 회장도 겸했다.
events.description_en: At the invitation of the Taiwanese government he became president of the Industrial Technology Research Institute. He simultaneously served as chairman of United Microelectronics Corporation.

events.title: TSMC를 세워 파운드리 사업을 열다
events.title_en: He founded TSMC and opened the foundry business
events.description: 자체 설계 없이 남의 설계를 위탁받아 생산만 전문으로 하는 TSMC를 세웠다. 세계 최초의 순수 파운드리 회사였다.
events.description_en: He founded TSMC as a company that manufactured chips designed by others, without designing its own. It was the world's first pure-play semiconductor foundry.

events.title: CEO 자리에서 물러나다
events.description: CEO 자리를 후임에게 넘기고 회장직만 유지했다. TSMC 창립 이후 처음으로 경영 일선에서 물러난 것이었다.
events.description_en: He handed the CEO post to a successor and kept only the chairmanship. It was the first time he had stepped back from day-to-day management since founding TSMC.

events.title: 금융위기 속에 CEO로 복귀하다
events.title_en: He returned as CEO amid the financial crisis
events.description: 글로벌 금융위기로 회사가 흔들리자 다시 CEO 자리에 복귀했다. 후임 체제로는 위기를 넘기기 어렵다고 판단한 결정이었다.
events.description_en: As the global financial crisis shook the company, he returned to the CEO post himself. He judged that the successor's leadership could not carry the company through the downturn.

events.title: 회장직에서 완전히 물러나다
events.title_en: He fully retired from the chairmanship
events.description: 여든일곱 나이로 TSMC 회장직에서 완전히 물러났다. 마크 리우가 뒤를 이어 회장을 맡았다.
events.description_en: At eighty-seven he stepped down entirely from the TSMC chairmanship. Mark Liu succeeded him as chairman.
